Among the first banks were the Bank of Hindustan, which was established in 1770 and liquidated in 1829–32; and the General Bank of India, established in 1786 but failed in 1791.  The largest and the oldest bank which is still in existence is the State Bank of India (SBI).  It originated and started working as the Bank of Calcutta in mid-June 1806.
